content.text:
The drawing shows a CCl3 carbon (three Cl labels) joined by a single bond to a carbon bearing two CH3 groups and an OH. This is 1,1,1-trichloro-2-methylpropan-2-ol (chlorobutanol).

All bonds are plain, and the carbinol carbon has two identical methyl groups, so it is not a stereocentre and no stereochemistry is needed.

SMILES: CC(C)(O)C(Cl)(Cl)Cl
